parsed.post: The attempt to scale DEPTH=6 with current LR resulted in 1.027319, worse than our best of 1.009912. Reverting to 3734fbf. It appears the larger model needs a more aggressive learning rate or a different warmup to converge effectively within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Increase MATRIX_LR to 0.07 and double WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to help the DEPTH=6 model converge faster and more effectively within the 5-minute limit.
